definitions.basket: AQE's own thematic baskets, equal-weight index (each name rebased to its first value, mean across names)
definitions.bullish: index closes above its EMA9, EMA21 and SMA50 (the 200-day is context only); AQE's own rule, Valen's is unpublished
definitions.sessions_on: consecutive sessions the bullish flag has held; negative = sessions it has been off
definitions.rs_1m: percentile rank 0-100 (steps of 5) of the 21-session return across the baskets; thrust = the same on 5 sessions; AQE's own formula, Valen's is unpublished
definitions.days_rs_80: of the last 60 sessions, sessions with rs_1m at 80 or above
definitions.atrx: today's index move divided by its 14-session mean absolute daily move (index-level proxy, no true high/low)
definitions.dryup: of the last 10 sessions, how many traded 45% / 60% under the 50-day average volume

definitions.thrust: percentile of the 5-session return across the group ETFs (Valen's reading guide: money pushing in this week)
definitions.rs_1m: percentile of the 21-session return across the group ETFs (the proof: group vs the rest this month)
definitions.reading: high both = leadership; high thrust, low 1M = new money not proven; high 1M, low thrust = a leader resting

gex.commentary: Below flip: moves get amplified. Cut size, tighten stops.
gex.assumption: Customers are long calls and long puts, so dealers are long call gamma and short put gamma. This is the standard convention, NOT observed data — exchange feeds publish open interest, never who is on which side.
gex.dealer_read: Volatile market — dealers are short gamma and amplify moves in both directions: support ~720, breakout level ~739 (reclaiming it calms the market), resistance ~775.

because: SPY is below its short-term lines on both the daily and weekly charts — the index is in a downtrend.
